meta.description: Part 2 governance guard bootstrap — 11 rules, Part2OnlyFlag enforcement, cross-part collision detection, all active from first content write

details.name: question_state → REVISION_HISTORY_P2.md pairing
details.description: Every question_state change must pair with a knowledge/REVISION_HISTORY_P2.md entry. Flagged at session idle.

details.name: ExplanationWrong[CorrectChoice] must be empty (DL-008)
details.description: ExplanationWrong slot matching CorrectChoice must be empty string. Single-object architecture eliminates CC-offset false positives.

details.name: MASTER_QUESTION_REGISTRY_P2.md is generated, never hand-edited
details.description: Registry is derived output from build_master_registry_p2.js. Any hand-edit is blocked.

details.name: answer-key changes must include recomputed verification note
details.description: Any CorrectChoice or Correct value change must include 'recomputed' or 'independently verified' note.

details.name: ≤30 question objects per change-set
details.description: No more than 30 question objects per change-set without BLOCK-AUTHORIZED marker.

details.name: non-CorrectChoice ExplanationWrong slots must be non-empty (DL-026)
details.description: All three distractor ExplanationWrong slots must contain choice-specific text (minimum 1 character checked structurally).

details.name: DERIVED_REGISTRY_NOT_AUTHORITATIVE
details.description: Derived registries (CURRENT_BASELINES_P2.md, MASTER_QUESTION_REGISTRY_P2.md, etc.) must not be hand-edited.

details.name: UNTRACKED_ARTIFACT — session packages must be registered
details.description: Session packages written to scripts/output/session_packages_p2/ must have registry entries.

details.name: Choice binary lead-in polarity mismatch (DL-037)
details.description: No + affirmative conclusion or Yes + negative conclusion patterns in choice text.

details.name: non-CC ExplanationWrong slots must be present and non-empty (DL-021)
details.description: All 4 ExplanationWrong fields must exist in the object; distractor slots must be non-empty.

details.name: Part2OnlyFlag must be true on every item
details.description: Every P2 item must carry Part2OnlyFlag: true (strict boolean). Absent, false, or non-boolean → BLOCK.

mechanisms.detail: Rejects any P1- QID prefix in P2 packs. Rejects any QID not matching P2 format.
Mandatory boolean true on every item. Serves as programmatic cross-contamination prevention.
Flags items mentioning P1-exclusive concepts: standard costing variances, process costing, job order costing, joint product cost allocation, COSO IC 2013 detailed procedures.
